content.comment_body: Is [product_name] V8.2 and V8.3 compatible with Windows 11?
[company_name] has only tested these versions with Windows 10.
When will [product_name] V8.3 be compatible with Windows 11?
There is currently no set release date for Windows 11 compatibility. Java support for Windows 11 needs to be provided first.
Hello, Are there any updates regarding Windows 11 Pro support?
Since June, I have been using Windows 11 Pro. I have installed [product_name] V8.0 through V8.4 on my PC, and all of these versions work without any issues.

I installed version V8.0 from a CD and upgraded to V8.4 on Windows 11. However, I faced several issues importing old files that were previously used on Windows 10—I couldn't save changes or even properly view the files. After loading a random file from my old hard disk (from the Windows 10 PC), the program functionality would break until I reinstalled the software, which then allowed me to access and edit preloaded sample files or newly created ones, but not the older files from my previous hard disk. When importing these same files into another PC running Windows 7, I am able to view and edit them without problems. I hope [company_name] resolves this issue quickly, as it's frustrating to have to redo programs just because of compatibility problems with the newer operating system version.

Hello [user_name], English is preferred in this forum. Please post in English. Thank you. English translation: I've installed Windows 11 Pro as my operating system. In my setup, I have installed [product_name] V6, V7, V8.0 up to V8.4.1. I do not experience issues loading, modifying, or saving older programs with any of these versions.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are discussing compatibility of [product_name] V8.x with Windows 11. While some report successful operation across multiple versions, others face problems importing and modifying legacy files from previous Windows versions, often requiring reinstalling the software to restore functionality. Experiences vary, especially around data migration and backward compatibility, highlighting reliability and consistency concerns when moving from Windows 10 to Windows 11.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] V8.x to function smoothly on Windows 11, with reliable and effortless import, editing, and saving of files created on Windows 10.
